32000.a:
- **Workflow** — `.github/workflows/*.yml` fayl, `on:` event'lar bilan trigger bo'ladi.
- **Job** — bitta **runner** (VM/container) da ishlaydi. Job'lar default **parallel**; tartib `needs:` bilan.
- **Step** — job ichida ketma-ket; `run:` (shell) yoki `uses:` (action).
- **Action** — qayta ishlatiladigan blok (`actions/checkout@v4`): JS, Docker yoki composite.

```yaml
on: [push]
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: go test ./...
```

Step'lar bitta workspace'ni bo'lishadi; job'lar **yo'q** (alohida mashina).

32001.a:
```yaml
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths: ['src/**']
  pull_request:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 3 * * *'   # UTC
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      env: { type: choice, options: [stg, prod] }
```

- `schedule` — faqat **default branch**da, UTC, kechikishi mumkin.
- `paths` filter — monorepo'da keraksiz build'ni kesadi.
- `workflow_call` — reusable workflow.

32002.a:
| | GitHub-hosted | Self-hosted |
|---|---|---|
| Muhit | har job toza VM | o'zing boshqarasan, state qoladi |
| Narx | daqiqa bo'yicha | o'z infra |
| Tarmoq | public | private resurslarga kirish |
| Xavf | izolyatsiya bor | public repo + fork PR = RCE xavfi |

Self-hosted'ni **public repo**da ishlatmaslik kerak — fork PR sening mashinangda kod ishlatadi. Production'da: ephemeral runner (ARC, K8s'da har job yangi pod).

32003.a:
```yaml
- run: ./deploy.sh
  env:
    TOKEN: ${{ secrets.DEPLOY_TOKEN }}
```

- Darajalar: **repository**, **environment** (approval bilan), **organization**.
- Mask faqat aniq qiymatni yashiradi — base64 qilingan yoki bo'lingan qiymat log'ga chiqib ketadi.
- Secret'ni `run:` ichida to'g'ridan-to'g'ri `${{ }}` bilan emas, `env:` orqali bering (injection'dan himoya).

32004.a:
```yaml
jobs:
  build: { ... }
  deploy:
    needs: build
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
```

- `needs` bo'lmasa job'lar parallel.
- Oldingi job fail bo'lsa keyingisi **skip**; `if: always()` yoki `failure()` bilan o'zgartiriladi.
- DAG hosil bo'ladi: `needs: [lint, test]`.

32005.a:
```yaml
strategy:
  fail-fast: false
  max-parallel: 4
  matrix:
    go: ['1.22', '1.23']
    os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]
    exclude:
      - { go: '1.22', os: macos-latest }
runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
```

- `fail-fast: true` (default) — bitta fail qolganini bekor qiladi; flaky testni yashiradi, shuning uchun ko'pincha `false`.
- Limit: 256 job/matrix.

32006.a:
```yaml
- uses: actions/cache@v4
  with:
    path: ~/go/pkg/mod
    key: go-${{ hashFiles('**/go.sum') }}
    restore-keys: go-
- uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
  with: { name: bin, path: dist/ }
```

| | Cache | Artifact |
|---|---|---|
| Maqsad | tezlik | natija |
| Kafolat | yo'qolishi mumkin | retention davomida bor |
| Scope | branch + default branch | run |

Cache'ga ishonib correctness qurmang — cache miss ham ishlashi shart.

32007.a:
```yaml
# chaqirish
jobs:
  ci:
    uses: org/shared/.github/workflows/go-ci.yml@v1
    with: { go: '1.23' }
    secrets: inherit
```

- **Reusable workflow**: job darajasida, o'z `runs-on`, environment, nesting 4 daraja.
- **Composite action**: step darajasida, `action.yml` + `runs.using: composite`, workspace umumiy.

Qoida: platforma standarti (lint+test+scan) — reusable workflow; kichik takrorlanuvchi qadam — composite.

32008.a:
```yaml
deploy:
  environment:
    name: production
    url: https://app.example.com
```

- Production secret faqat shu environment job'iga beriladi.
- **Required reviewers** — manual gate.
- **Deployment branches** — faqat `main`/tag.
- Deployment tarixi UI'da ko'rinadi (audit).

32009.a:
```yaml
concurrency:
  group: deploy-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false
```

- PR CI: `cancel-in-progress: true` — daqiqa tejaydi.
- Production deploy: `false` — yarim deploy bekor qilinmasin, navbatga tursin.
- Guruh kaliti noto'g'ri bo'lsa (masalan hamma uchun bitta) — barcha branch bir-birini bloklaydi.

32010.a:
- `pull_request` — fork PR'da secret yo'q, token read-only. Xavfsiz.
- `pull_request_target` — base branch workflow'i, **secret bor**.

Xavfli pattern:
```yaml
on: pull_request_target
steps:
  - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    with: { ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }} }
  - run: make test   # hujumchi Makefile'i secret bilan ishlaydi
```

Yechim: untrusted kodni `pull_request`da ishlat, natijani artifact qilib, `workflow_run` bilan secret'li job'da faqat **ma'lumot** sifatida o'qi. Label-gate (`safe-to-test`) ham yordam beradi.

32011.a:
```yaml
# XATO
- run: echo "${{ github.event.pull_request.title }}"
# TO'G'RI
- run: echo "$TITLE"
  env:
    TITLE: ${{ github.event.pull_request.title }}
```

Expression shell ishga tushishdan **oldin** almashtiriladi — quoting yordam bermaydi. Untrusted: title, body, branch nomi, commit message, issue comment. Tekshirish: `zizmor`, `actionlint`.

32012.a:
```yaml
permissions:
  id-token: write
  contents: read
steps:
  - uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4
    with:
      role-to-assume: arn:aws:iam::123:role/deploy
      aws-region: eu-central-1
```

Foyda: uzoq yashovchi access key yo'q, rotation kerak emas, leak bo'lsa ~1 soatda o'ladi.

Xato: trust policy'da `sub` ni `repo:org/*` qilib keng ochish — har qanday repo/branch deploy qila oladi. To'g'ri: `repo:org/app:environment:production`.

32013.a:
```yaml
permissions: {}            # workflow default: hech narsa
jobs:
  release:
    permissions:
      contents: write
      packages: write
```

- Token faqat shu run davomida yashaydi, lekin compromised step (masalan zararli action) u bilan repo'ga push qilishi mumkin.
- `GITHUB_TOKEN` bilan qilingan push yangi workflow trigger qilmaydi (rekursiyadan himoya) — kerak bo'lsa GitHub App token.

32014.a:
```yaml
- uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
```

- Dependabot `github-actions` ecosystem SHA'ni yangilab turadi.
- Org policy: faqat allowlist action'lar.
- Action ham supply chain — u job'ning barcha secret va token'iga kira oladi.
- Qo'shimcha: `step-security/harden-runner` bilan egress monitoring.

32015.a:
```yaml
stages: [build, test, deploy]

build:
  stage: build
  script: go build ./...

unit:
  stage: test
  script: go test ./...
```

- Stage'dagi barcha job tugamaguncha keyingi stage boshlanmaydi (`needs` bo'lmasa).
- Default stage'lar: `.pre, build, test, deploy, .post`.

32016.a:
- Runner GitLab'ga **poll** qiladi (pull model) — inbound port kerak emas.
- Turlari: **shared** (instance), **group**, **project**.
- `tags:` bilan job kerakli runner'ga yo'naltiriladi.

| Executor | Izolyatsiya |
|---|---|
| shell | yo'q, host'da |
| docker | har job yangi container |
| kubernetes | har job pod |

Production: docker/kubernetes, shell executor faqat ishonchli muhitda.

32017.a:
```yaml
variables:
  GO_VERSION: '1.23'

deploy:
  script: ./deploy.sh "$CI_COMMIT_SHA"
```

- Predefined: `CI_COMMIT_SHA`, `CI_COMMIT_REF_NAME`, `CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE`, `CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE`.
- Secret'ni `.gitlab-ci.yml`ga yozmang — UI variable + Protected + Masked.
- Precedence: trigger/manual > project > group > instance > YAML.

32018.a:
```yaml
test:
  image: golang:1.23
  services:
    - name: postgres:16
      alias: db
  variables:
    POSTGRES_PASSWORD: test
    DATABASE_URL: postgres://postgres:test@db:5432/postgres
  script: go test ./...
```

Service'ga hostname = `alias` (yoki image nomidan). Faqat docker/kubernetes executor'da.

32019.a:
```yaml
build:
  script: go build -o app
  artifacts:
    paths: [app]
    expire_in: 1 week
  cache:
    key:
      files: [go.sum]
    paths: [.go/pkg/mod]
```

- Artifact ishonchli, keyingi job'lar default oladi (`dependencies`/`needs` bilan cheklash).
- Cache yo'q bo'lishi mumkin — pipeline baribir to'g'ri ishlashi shart.

32020.a:
```yaml
deploy:
  rules:
    - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == $CI_DEFAULT_BRANCH
      when: manual
    - if: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == 'merge_request_event'
      changes: [k8s/**]
    - when: never
```

Gotcha: hech bir rule mos kelmasa job **qo'shilmaydi**. `workflow:rules` — butun pipeline yaratilishini boshqaradi (MR + branch duplicate pipeline'ni oldini olish).

32021.a:
```yaml
lint:     { stage: test, script: make lint }
build-a:  { stage: build, script: make a }
test-a:
  stage: test
  needs: [build-a]
  script: make test-a
```

- `needs: []` — darhol boshlanadi.
- `needs` artifact'ni ham faqat ko'rsatilgan job'lardan oladi (`artifacts: false` bilan o'chirish).
- Monorepo'da `changes` + `needs` = faqat o'zgargan servis build bo'ladi.

32022.a:
```yaml
include:
  - project: platform/ci-templates
    ref: v2.1.0
    file: /go.yml

.go-base:
  image: golang:1.23
  before_script: [go mod download]

test:
  extends: .go-base
  script: go test ./...
```

- `.` bilan boshlangan job — hidden (shablon).
- `include` `ref` ni tag'ga pin qiling — `main` o'zgarsa hamma pipeline buziladi.
- Yangi yo'l: **CI/CD Components** (`include: component:`) — versiyalangan, input'li.

32023.a:
```yaml
review:
  script: helm upgrade --install app-$CI_MERGE_REQUEST_IID ./chart
  environment:
    name: review/$CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG
    url: https://$CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG.dev.example.com
    on_stop: stop-review
    auto_stop_in: 2 days
```

Protected environment — faqat ruxsat etilgan user deploy qiladi. `resource_group` — bir environment'ga parallel deploy'ni taqiqlaydi.

32024.a:
```yaml
generate:
  script: ./gen-ci.sh > child.yml
  artifacts: { paths: [child.yml] }

run-child:
  trigger:
    include:
      - artifact: child.yml
        job: generate
    strategy: depend
```

- `strategy: depend` — parent child natijasini kutadi.
- Monorepo: har servis o'z child pipeline'i.
- Dinamik pipeline — matrix'dan murakkab holatlar uchun.

32025.a:
- Developer `.gitlab-ci.yml` ni o'zgartira oladi = pipeline'da istalgan kod. Shuning uchun production secret **faqat** protected variable bo'lsin.
- Protected branch'ga push/merge faqat Maintainer.
- Fork MR pipeline'lari default parent project secret'larini olmaydi.
- Qo'shimcha: protected environment + required approval, **pipeline execution policy** (security scan majburiy), `CODEOWNERS` `.gitlab-ci.yml` uchun.

Masked ham kafolat emas: `echo $X | rev` maskani chetlab o'tadi.

32026.a:
```yaml
deploy:
  id_tokens:
    AWS_TOKEN:
      aud: sts.amazonaws.com
  script:
    - aws sts assume-role-with-web-identity --role-arn $ROLE --web-identity-token $AWS_TOKEN ...
```

- Trust policy'da `sub` = `project_path:grp/app:ref_type:branch:ref:main` — tor qiling.
- `CI_JOB_TOKEN` scope: Settings > CI/CD > Job token permissions — inbound allowlist (default yopiq).

32027.a:
1. **Measure**: qaysi job critical path'da.
2. `rules: changes: [services/a/**]` + `compare_to: refs/heads/main`.
3. `needs` bilan stage barrier'ni olib tashlash.
4. `parallel: 5` + test sharding (`CI_NODE_INDEX`).
5. Cache: `key: files: [go.sum]`, `policy: pull` ko'p job uchun, faqat bitta job `push`.
6. Docker layer cache / prebuilt CI image.
7. `interruptible: true` + auto-cancel redundant pipelines.

Trade-off: `changes` shared kutubxona o'zgarishini o'tkazib yuborishi mumkin — dependency grafini hisobga oling.

32028.a:
Muammo: A va B alohida yashil, birga merge qilinganda `main` buziladi (semantic conflict).

- **Merged results pipeline**: `source + target` merge commit'ida ishlaydi.
- **Merge train**: A, A+B, A+B+C parallel test; B fail bo'lsa train qayta quriladi.

Trade-off: runner sarfi oshadi, flaky test butun navbatni sekinlashtiradi — flaky'ni avval tuzating. GitHub analogi: merge queue.

32029.a:
- `privileged = true` + DinD = root on host. Alternativa: **kaniko**, **buildah**, BuildKit rootless.
- Ephemeral: kubernetes executor, har job yangi pod, tugagach o'chadi.
- Production deploy runner — alohida, `tags` bilan, faqat protected ref.
- Image'larni digest bilan pin qiling (`golang@sha256:...`).
- Dependency proxy / mirror — tashqi registry'ga bog'liqlik va typosquatting xavfini kamaytiradi.
- SLSA provenance: build'ni imzolash (cosign).

32030.a:
```
+------------+   JNLP/SSH   +---------+
| Controller | -----------> | Agent 1 |
|  UI, queue |              +---------+
|  plugins   | -----------> | Agent 2 (K8s pod)
+------------+
```

- Controller'da executor soni = 0 qiling (xavfsizlik + barqarorlik).
- Agent ulanishi: SSH (controller ulanadi) yoki inbound/JNLP (agent ulanadi).
- Hammasi plugin orqali — kuchli, lekin plugin'lar asosiy muammo manbai.

32031.a:
- **Freestyle**: click-ops, tarix/review yo'q, murakkab oqim qiyin.
- **Pipeline**: Pipeline-as-Code, `Jenkinsfile` repo'da, PR'da review qilinadi, stage view.
- **Multibranch Pipeline**: har branch/PR uchun avtomatik job.

Yangi ish faqat Pipeline bilan.

32036.a:
```
shared-lib/
  vars/goPipeline.groovy   // goPipeline() step
  src/org/acme/Utils.groovy
  resources/templates/
```

```groovy
@Library('platform-lib@v1.4.0') _
goPipeline(service: 'billing')
```

- Global (trusted) library sandbox'siz ishlaydi — faqat admin o'zgartirsin.
- `@main` ga bog'lanish — bitta commit hamma pipeline'ni sindiradi; tag'ga pin qiling.

32040.a:
- Pipeline kodi **controller**da ishlaydi, `sh` esa agent'da. Og'ir Groovy hisob = controller CPU/heap.
- `NotSerializableException` — masalan `Matcher` ni o'zgaruvchida saqlash.
- `@NonCPS` metod — resume qilinmaydi, ichida step (`sh`) chaqirib bo'lmaydi.
- Script approval'da `staticMethod` ni ko'r-ko'rona approve qilish = controller'da RCE.

Qoida: logika `sh` skript/CLI'da, Jenkinsfile faqat orkestratsiya.

32041.a:
- **Attack surface**: plugin'lar — eng ko'p CVE manbai. Minimal set, muntazam update, `Script Security` approval nazorati.
- **Script console** = root RCE — faqat admin.
- **JCasC** (Configuration as Code) — YAML, review qilinadi, disaster'dan tez tiklash.
- Credential'lar folder scope'da, global emas.
- Agent-to-controller security yoqiq.
- Monitoring: queue length, executor utilisation, heap, GC pause.
- HA yo'q (OSS) — tez tiklanish uchun immutable controller image + JCasC + backup.

32042.a:
1. `/manage/systemInfo`, Prometheus plugin metrikalari.
2. Thread dump — qaysi plugin/job osilgan.
3. GC log — heap yetmayapti yoki leak.
4. `buildDiscarder(logRotator(numToKeepStr: '30'))` — tarixni cheklash.
5. Durability: `options { durabilityHint('PERFORMANCE_OPTIMIZED') }` — disk I/O kamayadi, lekin crash'da resume yo'q.
6. Og'ir Groovy (JSON parse, loop) ni `sh` + `jq` ga ko'chirish.
7. Katta artifact'larni stash/archive o'rniga Nexus/S3.

Root cause'ni topmasdan heap'ni oshirish — symptom'ni yashiradi.

32043.a:
| | GitHub Actions | GitLab CI | Jenkins |
|---|---|---|---|
| Hosting | SaaS + self-hosted runner | SaaS/self-managed | faqat self-hosted |
| Konfig | YAML | YAML | Groovy |
| Ekotizim | Marketplace action | Components, templates | 1800+ plugin |
| Ops yuk | past | o'rta | yuqori |
| Kuchli tomon | GitHub bilan integratsiya, OIDC | yagona platforma (SCM+CI+registry+security) | moslashuvchanlik, on-prem |

Qaror mezoni: kod hosting, compliance (air-gapped), ops jamoasi bor-yo'qligi, migratsiya narxi. Jenkins'dan ko'chishda — avval logikani skriptlarga (make/Taskfile) chiqaring, shunda CI faqat orkestrator bo'ladi.

32044.a:
- Snowflake agent (qo'lda o'rnatilgan tool) — "mening agent'imda ishlaydi" muammosi. Docker/K8s agent + digest pin.
- `checkout scm` aniq SHA'ni oladi — release build'ni tag'dan.
- Dependency: proxy repo, lockfile, checksum (`go.sum`).
- Imzo: `cosign sign`, SLSA provenance, SBOM (`syft`).
- Secret: Vault plugin + qisqa TTL, statik credential emas.
- Plugin'lar ham supply chain — update center'dan, versiya pin (plugins.txt).

33023.a:
```yaml
- run: make test
- if: failure()
  run: ./notify-slack.sh
- if: always()
  uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
  with: { name: logs, path: logs/ }
- if: github.event_name == 'push' && startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/')
  run: ./release.sh
```

Gotcha: `always()` bekor qilingan run'da ham ishlaydi — cleanup uchun `!cancelled()` ko'pincha to'g'riroq.

33024.a:
```yaml
env:
  APP: billing
jobs:
  deploy:
    environment: production
    steps:
      - run: ./deploy.sh --region "$REGION"
        env:
          REGION: ${{ vars.REGION }}
          TOKEN: ${{ secrets.TOKEN }}
```

- `vars` log'da ochiq — parol qo'ymang.
- Precedence: step `env` > job `env` > workflow `env`.
- Environment darajasidagi `vars`/`secrets` repo darajasidagini override qiladi.

33025.a:
```yaml
- id: ver
  run: echo "tag=$(git describe --tags)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
- run: echo "BUILD_ID=$RANDOM" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
- run: echo ${{ steps.ver.outputs.tag }} $BUILD_ID
```

- `GITHUB_PATH` — PATH'ga qo'shish.
- `GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY` — run sahifasiga Markdown hisobot.
- Ko'p qatorli qiymat: `EOF` delimiter sintaksisi.

33026.a:
```yaml
permissions: { contents: read, packages: write }
steps:
  - uses: actions/checkout@v4
  - uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3
  - uses: docker/login-action@v3
    with:
      registry: ghcr.io
      username: ${{ github.actor }}
      password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
  - uses: docker/build-push-action@v6
    with:
      push: ${{ github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' }}
      tags: ghcr.io/${{ github.repository }}:${{ github.sha }}
      cache-from: type=gha
      cache-to: type=gha,mode=max
```

Tag sifatida `latest` emas, commit SHA — deploy aniq versiyani biladi.

33027.a:
```yaml
jobs:
  build:
    outputs:
      image: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.image }}
    steps:
      - id: meta
        run: echo "image=ghcr.io/app:${GITHUB_SHA}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
  deploy:
    needs: build
    steps:
      - run: helm upgrade app --set image=${{ needs.build.outputs.image }}
```

Katta ma'lumot (fayl) — artifact orqali; output limit ~1MB/job. Dinamik matrix: output'dan JSON + `fromJSON()`.

33028.a:
```yaml
jobs:
  changes:
    outputs: { svcs: ${{ steps.f.outputs.changes }} }
    steps:
      - uses: dorny/paths-filter@v3
        id: f
        with:
          filters: |
            billing: services/billing/**
            auth: services/auth/**
  build:
    needs: changes
    if: needs.changes.outputs.svcs != '[]'
    strategy:
      matrix: { svc: ${{ fromJSON(needs.changes.outputs.svcs) }} }
```

Trade-off: shared `pkg/` o'zgarsa hammasi build bo'lishi kerak — filter'ga qo'shing. Bo'sh matrix xato beradi — `if:` bilan himoya.

33029.a:
```yaml
on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: [CI]
    types: [completed]
jobs:
  deploy:
    if: github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success'
```

- `workflow_run` default branch kontekstida, secret bilan ishlaydi — fork PR artifact'ini **data** sifatida o'qing, ishga tushirmang.
- `gh workflow run deploy.yml -f env=prod` — CLI'dan dispatch.

33030.a:
```yaml
on:
  push:
    tags: ['v*.*.*']
jobs:
  release:
    permissions: { contents: write, packages: write }
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with: { fetch-depth: 0 }
      - uses: goreleaser/goreleaser-action@v6
        with: { args: release --clean }
        env: { GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }} }
```

- `fetch-depth: 0` — tarix kerak (changelog, `git describe`).
- Tag protection (ruleset) — kim tag qo'ya oladi.
- Build bir marta, xuddi shu artifact staging va prod'ga (rebuild yo'q).

33031.a:
```yaml
jobs:
  test:
    timeout-minutes: 15
    strategy:
      matrix:
        go: ['1.23']
        include:
          - go: tip
            experimental: true
    continue-on-error: ${{ matrix.experimental == true }}
    steps:
      - uses: nick-fields/retry@v3
        with: { max_attempts: 3, timeout_minutes: 5, command: make e2e }
```

Retry flaky testni yashiradi — faqat tarmoq/infra operatsiyalari uchun, testlar uchun emas.

33032.a:
```yaml
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: arc-runner-set   # scale set nomi
```

- **Ephemeral** — job tugagach pod o'chadi, keyingi job'ga state/secret qolmaydi.
- `minRunners: 0` — xarajat; lekin cold start (image pull) — node'da image pre-pull/cache.
- Runner group + repo allowlist — qaysi repo qaysi runner'dan foydalanadi.
- Cloud credential: node IAM emas, OIDC — aks holda har job node rolini oladi.
- Monitoring: queue time, pod start time.

33033.a:
```yaml
on:
  pull_request:
  merge_group:
```

- `merge_group` yo'q bo'lsa required check hech qachon kelmaydi — queue osilib qoladi.
- Tez check'lar PR'da, og'ir e2e — faqat `merge_group`da (xarajat).
- Flaky test butun navbatni to'xtatadi — quarantine kerak.
- Ruleset: required status checks + merge queue.

33034.a:
```yaml
permissions:
  id-token: write
  attestations: write
  packages: write
steps:
  - uses: docker/build-push-action@v6
    id: push
  - uses: actions/attest-build-provenance@v2
    with:
      subject-name: ghcr.io/org/app
      subject-digest: ${{ steps.push.outputs.digest }}
      push-to-registry: true
```

Nega: registry'ga kimdir qo'lda image push qilsa, provenance yo'q — cluster qabul qilmaydi. Reusable workflow'da build = SLSA Level 3 (build logikasini chaqiruvchi o'zgartira olmaydi).

33035.a:
1. **Detect**: JUnit report + test analytics, bir commit'da pass/fail bo'lgan testlar.
2. **Contain**: quarantine ro'yxati, owner + muddat.
3. **Root cause** odatda: `time.Now()`/sleep, test tartibiga bog'liqlik, global state, port to'qnashuvi, tashqi servis.
4. Go: `go test -count=50 -race -shuffle=on ./...` bilan reproduce.
5. **Prevent**: hermetic test (testcontainers), fake clock.

Retry flaky'ni yashiradi va haqiqiy race bug'ni production'ga o'tkazadi.

33036.a:
- `paths`/`paths-ignore` — docs o'zgarishi CI'ni ishga tushirmasin.
- `concurrency: cancel-in-progress` PR uchun.
- macOS daqiqasi ~10x qimmat — faqat kerak bo'lsa.
- Cache: Go mod + build cache (`actions/setup-go` cache: true), Docker `type=gha`.
- Test sharding matrix bilan; critical path'ni qisqartirish.
- Artifact retention'ni kamaytirish (storage).
- `timeout-minutes` — osilgan job 6 soat yemasin.

Trade-off: self-hosted arzon ko'rinadi, lekin ops va xavfsizlik narxi bor.

33037.a:
- `org/.github` yoki `platform-workflows` repo — `go-ci.yml@v3`.
- **Rulesets**: required status checks, required workflows (security scan majburiy), signed commits.
- Breaking o'zgarish — major versiya, eski versiyaga deprecation muddati.
- Inventory: qaysi repo qaysi versiyada — `gh api` / code search.
- Exception jarayoni: repo o'z workflow'ini qo'sha oladi, lekin required'ni o'chira olmaydi.

Prinsip: golden path — default oson, chetga chiqish mumkin, lekin ko'rinadigan.

33038.a:
```yaml
default:
  before_script: [go mod download]
test:
  script:
    - go test ./...
  after_script:
    - docker compose down || true
```

- `after_script` — `before_script`dagi `export` o'zgaruvchilarni ko'rmaydi (yangi shell).
- Timeout default 5 min.
- `default:` — barcha job'larga umumiy kalitlar.

33039.a:
```yaml
lint:
  allow_failure: true
e2e:
  timeout: 30m
  retry:
    max: 2
    when: [runner_system_failure, stuck_or_timeout_failure]
scan:
  allow_failure:
    exit_codes: [137]
```

`retry.when` bilan faqat infra xatoda qayta urinish — test fail'ini retry qilish flaky'ni yashiradi.

33040.a:
```yaml
workflow:
  rules:
    - if: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == 'merge_request_event'
    - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH && $CI_OPEN_MERGE_REQUESTS
      when: never        # MR bor bo'lsa branch pipeline'ni o'chir
    - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH
    - if: $CI_COMMIT_TAG
```

Shu pattern'siz MR ochilganda ikki pipeline (branch + MR) ishlaydi — runner isrofi.

33041.a:
```yaml
build-image:
  image: docker:27
  services: [docker:27-dind]
  script:
    - echo "$CI_REGISTRY_PASSWORD" | docker login -u "$CI_REGISTRY_USER" --password-stdin "$CI_REGISTRY"
    - docker build -t "$CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE:$CI_COMMIT_SHA" .
    - docker push "$CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE:$CI_COMMIT_SHA"
```

- `--password-stdin` — parol process ro'yxatida ko'rinmasin.
- DinD privileged runner talab qiladi; alternativa kaniko/buildah.

33042.a:
```yaml
test:
  parallel: 4
  script: ./run-tests.sh --shard $CI_NODE_INDEX/$CI_NODE_TOTAL

deploy:
  parallel:
    matrix:
      - REGION: [eu, us]
        ENV: [stg, prod]
  script: ./deploy.sh $ENV $REGION
```

`needs` matrix job'ning aniq nusxasiga: `needs: [{job: build, parallel: {matrix: [{ARCH: amd64}]}}]`.

33043.a:
```yaml
test:
  interruptible: true
deploy-prod:
  resource_group: production
  interruptible: false
```

- Ikki parallel deploy = race, eski versiya yangisini bosib ketishi mumkin — `resource_group` bilan.
- `process_mode`: `unordered`, `oldest_first`, `newest_first`.
- Auto-cancel redundant pipelines faqat `interruptible` job'larni to'xtatadi.

33044.a:
```yaml
lint:
  dependencies: []
deploy:
  needs:
    - job: build
      artifacts: true
    - job: test
      artifacts: false
```

Katta artifact'lar har job'ga yuklansa pipeline sekinlashadi va storage oshadi. `expire_in` — saqlash muddati.

33045.a:
```yaml
.setup:
  script:
    - go mod download

test:
  script:
    - !reference [.setup, script]
    - go test ./...
```

`extends` — butun kalitni birlashtiradi (hash merge, massivlarni almashtiradi). `!reference` — aniq bo'lakni joylashtiradi.

33046.a:
```yaml
nightly-e2e:
  rules:
    - if: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == 'schedule' && $SUITE == 'e2e'
```

```sh
curl -X POST -F token=$TRIGGER_TOKEN -F ref=main \
  -F 'variables[ENV]=stg' https://gitlab.example.com/api/v4/projects/42/trigger/pipeline
```

Schedule egasi kim bo'lsa pipeline o'sha user nomidan ishlaydi — u ketsa schedule to'xtaydi; service account'ga o'tkazing.

33047.a:
```toml
[[runners]]
  executor = "kubernetes"
  [runners.cache]
    Type = "s3"
    Shared = true
    [runners.cache.s3]
      BucketName = "ci-cache"
      BucketLocation = "eu-central-1"
  [runners.kubernetes]
    cpu_request = "1"
    memory_limit = "4Gi"
```

- `concurrent` (global) va `limit` (runner) — parallel job chegarasi.
- Request/limit bo'lmasa bitta og'ir job node'ni yeydi.
- Monitoring: runner Prometheus metrikalari, job queue duration.
- Spot instance — arzon, lekin job o'ldirilishi mumkin — `retry: when: runner_system_failure`.

33048.a:
```yaml
include:
  - template: Jobs/SAST.gitlab-ci.yml
  - template: Jobs/Secret-Detection.gitlab-ci.yml
  - template: Jobs/Dependency-Scanning.gitlab-ci.yml
  - template: Jobs/Container-Scanning.gitlab-ci.yml
```

- Developer `.gitlab-ci.yml` dan scan'ni olib tashlay oladi — shuning uchun **policy** darajasida majburlash.
- Shovqin: false positive'larni triage, aks holda jamoa e'tibor bermaydi.
- Secret topildi = rotate qil, faqat commit'dan o'chirish yetmaydi (tarixda qoladi).

33049.a:
- Faqat qisqa vaqt, maxfiy bo'lmagan branch'da, keyin log'ni o'chirish.
- Xavfsizroq: `CI_DEBUG_SERVICES`, aniq joyda `set -x` (secret ishlatilmaydigan qismda).
- Lokal reproduce: `gitlab-ci-local`, yoki runner image'ni `docker run -it` bilan.
- Pipeline editor > Validate / `ci/lint` API — sintaksis xatolar uchun.
- Job log retention va kim ko'ra olishi (public pipelines sozlamasi) tekshiriladi.

33050.a:
- Cluster API'ni internetga ochish va kubeconfig'ni CI variable'da saqlash shart emas.
- **Push (CI access)**: oddiy, lekin CI'da cluster huquqi bor.
- **Pull (Flux)**: cluster o'zi git'dan tortadi, drift tuzatiladi, audit = git log.
- Agent huquqini `ci_access` da aniq project/group va impersonation bilan cheklang.
- Rollback: git revert (GitOps) yoki environment > rollback (CI).

33051.a:
- Pipeline execution policy: `inject` (project pipeline'ga qo'shish) yoki `override` (o'rnini bosish).
- Separation of duties: deploy'ni tasdiqlovchi kod muallifi bo'lmasin (MR approval rules, protected environment approvals).
- Audit events: kim, qachon, nima deploy qildi.
- Trade-off: markaziy nazorat vs jamoa avtonomiyasi; policy o'zgarishi hamma project'ga ta'sir qiladi — versiyalash va bosqichma-bosqich rollout.

33052.a:
- Runner: autoscaling, bir nechta zona, `tags` bilan workload ajratish (build, deploy, GPU).
- Rate limit: ko'p runner GitLab API'ni poll qilib yuklaydi — `check_interval`.
- Object storage — local disk to'lib qolishining oldini oladi.
- Backup: `gitlab-backup` + secrets fayli (`gitlab-secrets.json`) — usiz CI variable'larni decrypt qilib bo'lmaydi.
- Upgrade yo'li: required stop versiyalar, avval staging.
- Observability: Prometheus, queue duration, Sidekiq backlog.

33055.a:
```groovy
options {
  timeout(time: 30, unit: 'MINUTES')
  buildDiscarder(logRotator(numToKeepStr: '20'))
  disableConcurrentBuilds(abortPrevious: true)
  timestamps()
}
```

`buildDiscarder` yo'q bo'lsa `JENKINS_HOME` cheksiz o'sadi.

33059.a:
- GitHub App > PAT: org darajasida, qisqa muddatli token, rate limit kattaroq.
- Webhook secret — soxta so'rovlardan himoya.
- Jenkins internetda bo'lmasa: smee/relay yoki faqat polling.
- Build natijasi PR'da required check sifatida — branch protection bilan.

33062.a:
```yaml
jenkins:
  numExecutors: 0
  securityRealm:
    oic: { ... }
  clouds:
    - kubernetes:
        name: k8s
        namespace: ci
credentials:
  system:
    domainCredentials:
      - credentials:
          - string: { id: slack, secret: "${SLACK_TOKEN}" }
```

- Secret'lar YAML'da emas — env/K8s Secret/Vault'dan interpolatsiya.
- UI'da qo'lda o'zgarish = drift; keyingi reload uni o'chiradi.
- DR: yangi controller = image + JCasC + job seed — daqiqalarda.

33063.a:
- **Assessment**: ishlatilmaydigan job'lar ko'p — avval o'chiring.
- Plugin xaritasi: har plugin funksiyasining ekvivalenti (yoki yo'qligi).
- Credential'lar: statikdan OIDC'ga o'tish imkoniyati.
- GitHub Actions Importer (`gh actions-importer`) — avtomatik konvertatsiya boshlang'ich nuqta sifatida.
- Xavf: o'ziga xos on-prem agent'lar (HSM, Windows, hardware) — self-hosted runner kerak.
- Muvaffaqiyat metrikasi: lead time, pipeline vaqti, fail rate, ops xarajati.
- Rollback: migratsiya davrida ikkala tizim ham ishlay oladi.

33064.a:
- **Pre-baked image**: tez-tez o'zgarmaydigan dependency'lar image'da.
- **PVC**: oddiy, lekin RWX parallel yozishda corruption xavfi — read-only mount + bitta yozuvchi job.
- **Proxy repo**: tarmoq tezligi + upstream uzilishiga chidamlilik.
- **Remote build cache**: eng yaxshi natija, lekin infra.

Trade-off: cache tezlik beradi, lekin hermetiklik va xavfsizlikni pasaytiradi (cache poisoning) — PR build'lar cache'ga yozmasin.

33065.a:
- Credential folder scope'da: A jamoasi B'ning prod secret'ini ishlata olmaydi.
- Lekin Jenkinsfile istalgan agent label'ini so'rashi mumkin — deploy agent'larini cheklash (Job Restrictions / K8s pod template ruxsatlari).
- Global Shared Library trusted — faqat platforma jamoasi.
- Bitta controller = bitta failure domain va plugin konflikti. Katta tashkilotda: controller per business unit (CloudBees modeli yoki oddiy bir nechta OSS controller + JCasC).

33067.a:
- Har plugin = attack surface + dependency daraxti + upgrade xavfi.
- UI'dan "Update all" prod'da — tasodifiy breaking change.
- `jenkins-plugin-cli --plugin-file plugins.txt` — reproducible image.
- LTS liniyasi, yiliga bir necha marta rejalashtirilgan upgrade.
- Tashlab ketilgan (unmaintained) plugin'larni almashtirish/olib tashlash.
- Jenkins Security Advisories — kritik CVE'da darhol patch.
